title: LLM mods
summary: Every agent and model provider is a mod. Install them from the site, or create your own to connect another command-line program, an ACP agent or an API. Jev treats them all the same, with the same gates, routing and usage records.
usage: Click Create mod in Settings › Mods (or Ctrl+K). It opens Dashboard › Mods on the site for the current environment. For a command-line mod, give the program and its command line: {model} becomes the chosen model, and {prompt} or {prompt_file}, alone in an argument, becomes the request or a file with it (without either, the request goes through standard input). If the program writes to the project, also give a read-only line for planning. For an ACP mod, give the program, the arguments that start its ACP mode, such as acp, and, if you want, the ids of its modes for Development and Planning. For an API mod, choose the protocol (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, OpenAI Responses or Manus tasks) and enter the address. The mod reaches the app at the next sync; there, add the API key if needed (it stays on this computer) and turn on the models Jev may use. In an organization's projects, its LLM policy applies: if it lists allowed agents, the mods you create stay off there.
